findings.text: the project filter is the only thing keeping another project's pointer out of this project's pace, and no case covers it (the fixture at tests/test_preflight_pace.py:967 takes a project no case varies), so deleting the filter would let a foreign project's fresher receipt inform this project's group with the gate still green.

the gate log the manifest names as evidence opens with the pytest progress line, so it does not name the revision, tree and command the delivery contract requires while sibling runs' logs do, leaving a later reader unable to tie the result to a tree.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against eb2ffd60 commit by commit; 95ba8ea7 carries the pointer home, the candidate-and-maximum rule and _reading_stamp, and cb69a87f carries the docs alone, insert-only on the plan landing, the cumulative evidence record's new section and the figure; the code half is one loop rewritten around the same helpers and the docs half carries no deletion.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_preflight_pace.py with three added cases, the 27 existing ones unmoved, and a declared control whose red log repeats the mutation verbatim; I re-ran the file at cb69a87f myself (PYTHONPATH=<target tree> .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_preflight_pace.py, 30 passed, exit 0), the base revision's own copy of that file runs 27 passed against this tree (base-suite.log), and negative-control.log:1 repeats "restore receipt-first precedence" with the named case red at assert 0.42 == 0.31 (1 failed, 29 passed).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that recorded_windows reads live run pointers beside committed ledger rows and, per member, takes the freshest dated reading whichever source carried it; reckon/budget.py:1945-1955 adds the pointer home through crew.list_live() scoped to the project, reckon/budget.py:1979-1990 builds one candidate per source that resolved a clock and takes the newest observed_at, and both halves are asserted end to end through the command's own payload.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the run manifest; it records status complete, both commits, a gate result matching its log to the line, the declared mutation verbatim on the control log's first line, and it states honestly that no live pointer on this workstation carries a lane_receipt so the pointer-as-receipt-home path is unexercised in production; its one shape defect is the gate log opening with the pytest progress line rather than a revision, tree and command (FINDING below).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the five declared paths are exactly the five the two commits touch (numstat 095ba8ea7: budget.py 62/21, test_preflight_pace.py 189/2; cb69a87f: plan 53/0, evidence 98/0, figure 49/0), nothing outside them, and both docs records are insert-only with no plan-version or plan-modified line among the zero deletions.

justifications.durability: each added case names the code change that reddens it - dropping pointer rows from the candidate loop reddens the first, restoring receipt-first precedence reddens the second (measured: negative-control.log, 1 failed, 29 passed), preferring the stream reddens the third - and they compare code output against fixture literals rather than values handed to the code; the deduction is that the project filter at reckon/budget.py:1952 has no assertion behind it, per the finding below.
justifications.evidence: every sub-claim the done_when makes is checkable and checks out - my own re-run of tests/test_preflight_pace.py at cb69a87f gave 30 passed exit 0, base-suite.log gives 27 passed for the base file, and negative-control.log:1 is the mutation verbatim with the named assertion going 0.42 against 0.31 - against the deduction that gate-preflight-pace.log:1 does not name the revision, tree and command the delivery contract requires.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's own idiom - an injectable keyword defaulting to the real source, beside the existing records parameter, a module-level helper with a mechanism docstring at reckon/budget.py:1994, and the _run_order fallback that pointer records require - and names nothing by plan, sprint or ticket.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/budget.py:1990 takes the newest observed_at across a member's last receipt from either home and its newest window-carrying stream, which is the goal's rule exactly, and both production call sites reach it; the reserve is that no live pointer here carries a lane_receipt, so the pointer home is exercised from synthesised pointers only, as the manifest itself states.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --numstat eb2ffd60..cb69a87f lists exactly the five declared paths with 451 insertions and 23 deletions, no deletion in either docs record, and no plan-version or plan-modified line among the changes.
